text:
Type: woven rectangular storage basket
Use: storing magazines, remotes, toys or throws on shelves; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: flat woven strips in a dark stained finish, rigid rim
Colors: dark charcoal brown, almost black
Shape: open rectangular box with a chunky basket weave, an open lattice row below the rim that works as handholds, sturdy, medium size
Feel: earthy, tidy, grounded, warm
Goes with: shelving units, light or dark wood, beige and white textiles; rustic, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: KNARRA
product.description: Collecting newspapers, toys, hats and gloves in baskets makes it easier to find what you need and keeps the room looking neat and uncluttered.
